facts.text: Audrey took her fur kids to the pet salon on Friday, and they were excited and had wagging tails.

evidence.quote: Last Friday I took my fur kids to the pet salon - they were so psyched and their tails were wagging like crazy!

facts.text: Audrey shared a photo of her fur kids after they were groomed, showing them with shiny coats.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats!

facts.text: Andrew expressed admiration for Audrey's fur kids being happy and calm in new places.

evidence.quote: Wow, they look great! Love seeing them happy and calm in new places.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that she worries about her fur kids in new places, but they were good at the salon.
